children: Hawaiian Electric Industries received $33.9 million in net proceeds from sales of ASB shares to fund Maui wildfire settlement needs.
Sold ~2.0M ASB shares in IPO on Sept 16, 2026, generating $29.5M net of fees.
Underwriters exercised option on Sept 21, 2026, adding 293,904 shares and $4.4M net.
Combined net proceeds of $33.9M will reduce future capital raises for Maui wildfire settlements.
Remaining pro forma stake of 6.4% in ASB valued at ~$73.5M based on Sept 18 close of $17.57.
Remaining ASB shares are subject to a 180-day lockup; future monetization will depend on market conditions.
